# Ask Janice

> Ask Janice is an AI receptionist for local businesses. It answers your calls 24/7, captures every lead, and books appointments straight into your calendar.

Ask Janice also includes a live chat bot for your website, SMS follow-up, and calendar booking. Two plans, both with a 7-day free trial and no contracts:

- Essential — $79/month, includes 200 call minutes per month and up to 3 call scenarios.
- Elite — $139/month, includes 750 call minutes per month, unlimited scenarios, and call transfers to a person.
